columns.name: origin_dc
columns.reason: Originating distribution centre is fixed when the shipment is created and loaded.

columns.name: grower_lot
columns.reason: Grower lot identity is assigned at packing, before the load ever moves.

columns.name: insurer_code
columns.reason: Cargo insurer/policy is normally attached at booking rather than at claim time.

columns.name: claims_office
columns.reason: A claims office is only routed once a spoilage claim exists, which follows the outcome.

columns.name: dest_dc
columns.reason: Destination distribution centre is set when the shipment is booked.

columns.name: appointment_band
columns.reason: Delivery appointment window is reserved in advance of dispatch.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q4
columns.reason: Ambient temperature over the final quarter of the run is only measured while in transit.

columns.name: disposal_ticket_usd
columns.reason: A disposal ticket is raised only for product condemned as spoiled, so it encodes the outcome.

columns.name: reefer_setpoint_c
columns.reason: The reefer set point is chosen and recorded at load time.

columns.name: temp_probe_model
columns.reason: Equipment attribute of the probe fitted before departure.

columns.name: pack_size
columns.reason: Product packaging specification known at pack-out.

columns.name: handling_unit_type
columns.reason: Handling unit is decided when the load is built.

columns.name: route_distance_km
columns.reason: Planned lane distance between the two DCs is known when the route is assigned.

columns.name: yard_slot
columns.reason: Yard/dock slot is allocated as part of origin loading operations.

columns.name: door_open_events
columns.reason: Door-opening count accumulates during the trip and is not final at dispatch.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q3
columns.reason: Third-quarter ambient route temperature is recorded en route, after the prediction point.

columns.name: calibration_lot
columns.reason: Probe calibration lot is a pre-existing equipment record.

columns.name: invoice_terms
columns.reason: Commercial payment terms are agreed on the order, before shipping.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q2
columns.reason: Second-quarter ambient route temperature only exists once that leg has been driven.

columns.name: driver_team_flag
columns.reason: Whether a team drives the load is decided at dispatch.

columns.name: commodity_code
columns.reason: Commodity being shipped is known from the order.

columns.name: load_plan_ver
columns.reason: Load plan version is finalised when the trailer is loaded.

columns.name: trailer_class
columns.reason: Trailer class is known once equipment is assigned at dispatch.

columns.name: carrier_scac
columns.reason: Carrier is tendered the load before it departs.

columns.name: seal_number_prefix
columns.reason: The seal is applied and recorded at origin loading.

columns.name: logger_download_max_c
columns.reason: Peak temperature is read off the logger at receipt and is the excursion evidence used to call spoilage.

columns.name: ambient_route_temp_q1
columns.reason: First-quarter ambient route temperature is measured after departure, not at dispatch.

columns.name: route_variant
columns.reason: Planned routing variant is chosen before the truck leaves.

columns.name: case_gtin_prefix
columns.reason: Product identifier attribute fixed at pack-out.

columns.name: booking_channel
columns.reason: How the shipment was booked is known at booking.

columns.name: inspection_desk
columns.reason: Inspection desk is an artefact of the destination QA review that produced the spoilage call.

columns.name: pallet_wrap_type
columns.reason: Wrap type is applied during palletising, before dispatch.

columns.name: post_arrival_hold_hours
columns.reason: Hold time accrues after arrival and reflects the disposition process itself.

columns.name: palletiser_line
columns.reason: The palletising line used is recorded at pack-out.

columns.name: depot_region
columns.reason: Static geography attribute of the handling depot.

columns.name: toll_zone
columns.reason: Toll zone follows from the planned lane and is known before departure.

columns.name: stack_limit_code
columns.reason: Stacking specification is part of the packaging standard.

columns.name: fuel_card_zone
columns.reason: Administrative fuel-card zone attached to the carrier/lane at dispatch.

columns.name: qa_excursion_severity_score
columns.reason: QA scores the temperature excursion as part of deciding the spoilage disposition.

columns.name: gate_in_shift
columns.reason: Gate-in shift labels a yard entry event around loading; treated as pre-dispatch operational metadata.

columns.name: arrival_pulp_temp_c
columns.reason: Pulp temperature is taken at receipt and is a direct input to the accept/spoiled decision.

columns.name: qa_hold_code_applied
columns.reason: A QA hold code is the disposition record that accompanies declaring the load spoiled.

columns.name: precool_hours
columns.reason: Precooling is completed before loading, so the value is final at dispatch.

columns.name: pallet_height_cm
columns.reason: Physical build dimension known once the pallet is assembled.

columns.name: customs_regime
columns.reason: Customs regime is declared as part of booking paperwork.

columns.name: label_stock
columns.reason: Label material is chosen at pack-out.

columns.name: reefer_unit_id
columns.reason: The reefer unit is assigned when equipment is hooked for dispatch.
